# monitor_op {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
monitor_op(data, lam, cl; chart_choice, m=3, d=1, add_noise=false)
```
Monitor the time series `data` with the EWMA control chart based on ordinal patterns and return a [`ControlChartResult`](ControlChartResult.qmd) with the chart statistics, the control limit and the first alarm.
 
The statistics are those of [`stat_op(data, lam; ...)`](stat_op.qmd), and the alarm rule is the one of the chart: the chart signals when the statistic falls below `cl` for [`Shannon()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) and [`ShannonExtropy()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), exceeds `cl` for [`DistanceToWhiteNoise()`](DistanceToWhiteNoise.qmd), and exceeds `cl` in absolute value for the four statistics of Bandt (2019).
 
  * `data`: the time series.
  * `lam::Float64`: EWMA smoothing parameter.
  * `cl::Float64`: control limit, typically obtained from [`cl_op`](cl_op.qmd).
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`Shannon()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon), [`ShannonExtropy()`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), [`DistanceToWhiteNoise()`](DistanceToWhiteNoise.qmd), [`UpDownBalance()`](UpDownBalance.qmd), [`Persistence()`](Persistence.qmd), [`RotationalAsymmetry()`](RotationalAsymmetry.qmd), [`UpDownScaling()`](UpDownScaling.qmd). For [`Shannon`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) and [`ShannonExtropy`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.ShannonExtropy), the statistic is in the logarithm base of the chart, which must be larger than 1. Both default to base 2 in ComplexityMeasures.jl; use [`Shannon(base=exp(1))`](https://juliadynamics.github.io/ComplexityMeasures.jl/stable/information_measures/#ComplexityMeasures.Shannon) for the natural logarithm used in the papers. The control limit `cl` must be given in the same base.
  * `m::Int=3`: length of the ordinal patterns.
  * `d::Int=1`: delay between observations of a pattern.
  * `add_noise::Bool=false`: add uniform noise to `data` to break ties.

```julia
x = randn(400)
res = monitor_op(x, 0.1, 0.25; chart_choice=Persistence())
res.alarm            # position of the first signal in res.stats, or nothing
```


:::
